businesses.business: Collector vehicle insurance and enthusiast services

offering_description.value: Hagerty sells specialty insurance to collector vehicle owners and businesses that work with classic cars. It administers policies for partner insurers and assumes a share of the risk through reinsurance. It also offers club memberships, roadside assistance, automotive media and events, and helps collectors buy, sell and finance vehicles.

primary_products.value: Collector vehicle insurance policies; insurance policies for classic car businesses

primary_services.value: Collector car club memberships and roadside assistance; vehicle auctions and private sales brokerage; collector car financing; vehicle valuation and automotive media; automotive events

customer_segment.value: B2C: Collector vehicle owners, buyers and sellers, and automotive enthusiasts; B2B: Partner insurers, collector car dealers, restoration shops, and automotive advertisers and sponsors

end_markets.value: Collector vehicle ownership and insurance; classic and collectible vehicle resale; automotive media and events

revenue_model.value: commissions or management fees: Insurance policy placement and administration, auction buyer premiums, and vehicle sales brokerage; interest or premiums: Premiums assumed through reinsurance and interest on collector car loans; subscription: Annual car club dues for roadside assistance, publications, and member benefits; service fees: Admission and participation fees for automotive events; advertising: Advertising in automotive publications and digital media, and sponsorship of automotive events
revenue_model.category: commissions or management fees; interest or premiums; subscription; service fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Places coverage with partner insurers for collectors and specialty businesses, assumes reinsurance risk, and lends to collectors; service provider: Arranges roadside help for members, sells consigned vehicles for owners, and produces media and events for enthusiasts; software / platform: Connects vehicle consignors with bidders through online auctions and gives collectors access to vehicle valuation data
value_chain_position.category: financial intermediary; service provider; software / platform

geography_served.value: global: Insurance in the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom, with collector car auctions in the United States and continental Europe

specialization.value: related lines: Collector vehicle insurance and reinsurance, club memberships, roadside assistance, auctions, financing, valuation, media, and events

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: In-house phone sales for insurance and specialists for consignments and private vehicle sales; agents / brokers: Independent insurance agents and brokers serving vehicle owners and specialty businesses; partners / resellers: Partner insurers and their agency networks offering collector vehicle coverage; online: Company websites for insurance quotes, club enrollment, valuation tools, and auction bidding; other: Live collector car auctions and automotive events
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; agents / brokers; partners / resellers; online; other

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Insurance agency licensing and policy rules enforced by state and other local insurance regulators, plus separate reinsurance oversight

notes: The current scope of smaller automotive enthusiast offerings is uncertain.
